task_text: Strike, catch and merge two balls: Two small balls wait behind closed shutters near the top of two parallel inclined lanes. The shutters open by themselves, the first shortly after the start and the second a few seconds later, and each released ball rolls down its lane and flies off the open lower end. The left Panda's paddle must touch each ball after the ball has flown free. The right Panda's cup must catch the first ball and carry it away from the catch point without losing it. The cup must then catch the second ball while still holding the first, and finally put both balls into a fixed basin, where they must come to rest with the cup no longer touching them. Phases, in order: first_redirect: At some moment during this phase, ball1 has flown free (touching nothing at all) for more than 0.025 s. After that, it touches the left paddle (panda-0's tool). Where the ball goes after the touch is not checked.; first_catch: ball1 enters the right cup (panda-1's tool) from above and is retained. The entry: after touching nothing for at least 0.025 s, the ball's centre passes downward through the plane 0.071 m above the cup floor (wall height 0.055 m + radius 0.016 m, in the cup's frame). At that crossing the centre must be within 0.054 m (`tool_half` - radius) of the cup centre along both cup x and cup y. From then on the ball must stay contained in the cup for 0.18 s without interruption. Contained in the cup means all of the following, in the cup's frame: |x| and |y| of the ball centre below 0.0628 m (`tool_half` - 0.45 x radius); height above the cup floor between 0.012 m and 0.0531 m; in contact with the cup within the last 25 ms; moving at less than 0.09 m/s relative to the cup (including the cup's rotation). The free-flight time counts only from the start of this phase. The cup's position when this phase completes is recorded as the catch position.; loaded_cup_relocation: With ball1 contained in the right cup (as defined in first_catch), the cup's tool-frame origin is more than 0.06 m from the recorded catch position.; second_redirect: At some moment during this phase, ball2 has flown free (touching nothing) for more than 0.025 s; only free flight while this phase is active counts. After that, ball2 touches the left paddle. Where the ball goes after the touch is not checked.; second_catch: ball2 enters the right cup from above and is retained exactly as in first_catch. That is: an entry after at least 0.025 s of free flight (counted from the start of this phase), crossing downward through the plane 0.071 m above the cup floor within 0.054 m of the cup centre on both axes, then contained in the cup for 0.18 s without interruption. At that moment ball1 must also be contained in the cup.; both_delivery: Both balls are contained in the basin and neither touches the cup, for 0.7 s without interruption. Contained in the basin means all of the following, in the basin's frame (origin at the centre of its floor's top surface, axes = world axes): |x| and |y| of the ball centre below 0.0728 m (0.08 - 0.45 x radius); height above the basin floor between 0.012 m and 0.0731 m; in contact with the basin within the last 25 ms; speed below 0.09 m/s. This completes the task. Goal geometry: All goal geometry is relative to the cup, the paddle or the basin.
episode: one episode, no reset: it ends at the first control step where the task has succeeded (every phase in order) or failed (a failure event, a forbidden contact, a safety-limit violation, an object out of bounds, or the task's horizon of 25 s of simulated time, 2500 control steps), when your time is up, or on a simulator error; the simulated clock advances only with the control steps you run
